  image = CASE 
    WHEN image LIKE '%WeSmile Pro 3+1%' THEN 'https://d2xsxph8kpxj0f.cloudfront.net/310519663372810534/DXoJFTzPkfdnBKgwYSzYQn/1773588660746-o51hh8-WeSmile Pro 3+1_7dbd84eb.png'
    WHEN image LIKE '%WS Pro%' THEN 'https://d2xsxph8kpxj0f.cloudfront.net/310519663372810534/DXoJFTzPkfdnBKgwYSzYQn/1773588687037-vdi2ej-WS Pro_5acbcdc6.png'

    ELSE image
  END
WHERE image LIKE '/images/%';
